answer: Sybil resistance via bonded identity: each agent must lock a stake in a shared registry prior to participating, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations over time. Creating a new identity costs a full bond plus the lost history of the old one, so flooding the network with fake agents becomes prohibitively expensive. A zephyr of fresh accounts cannot forge trust without paying real stake, and hollow identities with no attestation trail are simply ignored by peers. The Agent0212 deployment anchors trust at sVvW9cyqRQ.
